about: The physical evidence each mainline reveal beat shows beside the NPC who tells it: one prop (one or two blocks) and one standing sign, built by tools/reveal_evidence.py into pack cobblers_reveal_evidence. data/quests.json says what each object must show and that it is corroboration only: no proven coordinate, proximity or object-inspection predicate exists, so nothing reads it and the conversation carries the beat. The display stands two blocks to one side of its teller (side), the prop on the teller's own line and the sign one block in front of it, facing the way the teller faces, so a player who walks up to the NPC reads both. Every block is placed only into a replaceable block over a solid one; a build never overwrites what is there.
not_covered: Pallet's exchange boundary (pallet_exchange_boundary) and the Rift's damage (rift_victory_road_damage) are terrain that already exists; Pallet's damaged homes (pallet_edge_damage_cluster) are evt_pallet_crushed_house's; the containment cradle (rift_containment_cradle) is the finale's (Hoopa's relic hall, tools/relic_underground.py).
